checkpoint.inference_rule: pre-sigmoid reliability argmax (monotone sigmoid); fixed bank-order ties; selected FP32 expert; solver-ID ties

interpretation.capture_attribution: locked run/update, pinned producer, exact source identities and selected bank scores; original VAL/TEST captures have no embedded checkpoint SHA; this is not a retroactive capture signature
interpretation.query_costs_used: offline validation/decomposition only, never a forward input
interpretation.source_novelty: source-record certificate only; exhaustive same-base/content novelty unproven
interpretation.support_only: closed-simplex geometry for this frozen bank and specified score pool
interpretation.three_expert_precompute_cost: full train+val+postlock test three-expert cache is required and not free; the helper does not record elapsed GPU time, so its numeric construction cost remains unavailable, not zero

numerical_policy.boundary: neither certified reachable nor unreachable; never counted as rescued
numerical_policy.boundary_extra_lp: maximize lower-ID margin subject to nonnegative gaps to every other rival
numerical_policy.certificates: positive primal witness or negative directly checked rival-mixture dual bound
numerical_policy.lp: max-min margin, 3 nonnegative expert weights summing to 1; highs-ds; maxiter1000, 2s/call
numerical_policy.scale: per-query max absolute target-minus-rival score difference; zero -> 1
numerical_policy.ties: equal scores: lowest global solver ID; lower-ID rivals require STRICT separation

population: full18 frozen VAL4500/task + TEST4500/task; no TRAIN or LIB added

score_geometry.logits: original FP32 logits cast to FP64, no per-expert rescaling
score_geometry.probability: FP64 stable softmax of original FP32 logits, temperature=1

winner: saved native int64 winner; exact FP64 cost minimum verified; cost ties NOT relabeled by ID
